title: #250 Goal Pursuit
prompt: Whatever happens, we should keep trying and never stop pursuing our goals. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Discuss it with your own experience.

promptSegments.text: Whatever happens, we should keep trying and never stop pursuing our goals.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
Discuss it with your own experience.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point discusses how continuous effort is necessary to achieve goals, even after failure.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point discusses how continuous effort is necessary to achieve goals, even after failure.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point explains that having a strong will is key to continuing the effort when facing difficulties.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point explains that having a strong will is key to continuing the effort when facing difficulties.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that while effort is good, it is not always necessary to keep trying when things are too hard, and sometimes changing goals is a better idea.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that while effort is good, it is not always necessary to keep trying when things are too hard, and sometimes changing goals is a better idea.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay provides two reasons why the original statement is wrong: 1) Accepting setbacks and resting is sometimes better than continuous effort. 2) Changing goals when life changes is a smart and necessary choice.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay provides two reasons why the original statement is wrong: 1) Accepting setbacks and resting is sometimes better than continuous effort. 2) Changing goals when life changes is a smart and necessary choice.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point argues that persistence helps people improve their skills by showing that setbacks are normal parts of any journey toward a goal.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point argues that persistence helps people improve their skills by showing that setbacks are normal parts of any journey toward a goal.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second point argues that effort builds character and mental strength, showing that facing challenges teaches us how to be stronger.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second point argues that effort builds character and mental strength, showing that facing challenges teaches us how to be stronger.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The essay argues that constant, intense effort is not always the best strategy for achieving goals. Instead, it suggests that balance and setting realistic expectations are more effective.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay argues that constant, intense effort is not always the best strategy for achieving goals. Instead, it suggests that balance and setting realistic expectations are more effective.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The essay provides two main points: first, adjusting goals and finding balance is key, and second, setting manageable goals reduces stress and improves long-term success.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The essay provides two main points: first, adjusting goals and finding balance is key, and second, setting manageable goals reduces stress and improves long-term success.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
